name: io.github.darrenjrobinson/entra-scim-mcp
title: Microsoft Entra SCIM
description: Microsoft Entra SCIM 2.0 Provisioning API: user and group lifecycle, with a local mock.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Directory (tenant) GUID. Required to authenticate against a live tenant; not needed for ENTRA_SCIM_DRY_RUN or ENTRA_SCIM_STATIC_TOKEN, which supply their own placeholder.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: App registration (client) GUID. Required to authenticate against a live tenant; not needed for ENTRA_SCIM_DRY_RUN or ENTRA_SCIM_STATIC_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret value. For a live tenant set exactly one of ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET or ENTRA_CLIENT_CERT_PATH; a certificate is preferred for anything long-lived.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a PEM holding the certificate and its private key. Set exactly one of ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET or ENTRA_CLIENT_CERT_PATH.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the PEM, if it is encrypted.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_SCIM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the SCIM base URL (default https://graph.microsoft.com/rp/scim). Point it at the bundled mock to try the tools without a tenant.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_SCIM_STATIC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Use a fixed bearer token instead of Azure AD. Refuses any microsoft.com/microsoft.us host and requires ENTRA_SCIM_BASE_URL; intended for the local mock only.

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_SCIM_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run every client-side validation and return the request that would have been sent, without sending it or acquiring a token.
